HOW TELLWIN WORKS

Sales teams serve customers as usual.
TellWin handles the rest.

Two data pipelines feed one analysis engine: recording devices capture offline conversations, business systems such as WeCom connect online communication, and AI structures, analyzes, and distributes the result.

01 · CAPTURE

Effortless capture

Recording devices capture face-to-face conversations while WeCom can cover private-channel conversations, with customer consent and clear data boundaries.

02 · STRUCTURE

Turn conversations into customer profiles

AI extracts needs, budget, decision-makers, objections, competitor mentions, and tasks, then writes them to Lark Base or an existing CRM.

03 · ACT

Move insight into action

Role-based dashboards and operating reports organize sales strategy, needs, product and market feedback, and competitor activity into each team’s next step.

In-person recording＋WeCom→Customer profiles→Role dashboards & operating reports

BUILT FOR HIGH-VALUE SALES

One customer intelligence engine
adapts to high-value sales settings.

We prioritize high-ticket industries where conversion depends on deep conversations and customer assets are vulnerable to staff turnover. The core stays consistent while vocabulary, profile fields, and analysis templates adapt by industry.

01

Healthcare & medical devices

A professional conversation should not live only in a salesperson’s memory.

Doctors, departments, and procurement teams care about different things. Product information is specialized, decisions take time, and reviews often rely on handwritten sales notes.

  • Capture product questions and clinical concerns
  • Separate usage concerns, purchasing terms, and key stakeholders
  • Create accurate meeting summaries and internal action items
02

Automotive sales

The real sales work begins after the test drive.

Budget, model preferences, trade-ins, family opinions, and competitor comparisons are scattered through a long conversation, leaving follow-up reduced to “still considering.”

  • Extract model preferences, budget, and purchase timing
  • Identify pricing, configuration, and competitor objections
  • Give sales a clear recommendation for the next touchpoint
03

Real estate sales

Every viewing should make the next recommendation more accurate.

Clients weigh commute, schools, layout, floor, and payment options repeatedly. Information across multiple viewings is hard for teams to carry forward.

  • Capture stated needs and unspoken concerns
  • Organize decision-makers, timelines, and financing plans
  • Help agents prepare better-matched listings and conversations
